system.description:
Make an Interface Roll (10). On a success, mark a Stress and choose yourself or an ally within Melee range to become Invisible through optical camouflage, ghost skin, or sensor-scrambling tech.
An Invisible creature can’t be seen except through appropriate detection methods, and attack rolls against them are made with disadvantage.
Place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Interface trait. When the Invisible creature takes an action, spend a token from this card. After the action that spends the last token is resolved, the effect ends.
You can only run Ghost Skin on one creature at a time.
